rules.DOWNGRADE — DOES NOT BEAT B1: Primary 15s/15s US challenger pooled HOLDOUT improvement vs frozen B1 <= 0.
rules.DOWNGRADE — FAMILYWISE NULL NOT REJECTED: Primary 15s/15s US synchronized UTC-hour max-t familywise adjusted p >= 0.05.
rules.DOWNGRADE — DEPENDENCE-SENSITIVE: Among block-sensitivity rows eligible for a stable CI (>=4 effective block-equivalents), any primary 15s/15s US 95% CI has lower bound <= 0.
rules.RETAIN — TEMPORALLY CONCENTRATED: After clearing B1, multiplicity and stable-block checks, either the strongest positive UTC hour contributes >=50% of total positive advantage or removing that single hour makes pooled improvement vs B2 <= 0.

unstable_long_blocks: Rows with <4 effective block-equivalents are explicitly inconclusive and cannot by themselves retain or downgrade the result.
